option.label: Dagannoth Mother colour
option.description:
She can only be damaged by the style her current colour names.
The colour changes every 18 seconds on a fixed cycle; each is costed on its own.

source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Horror_from_the_Deep "For as long as she remains that colour, she can only be damaged through use of that particular attack style"; the six colours and their styles are that guide's weakness table. She changes every 18 seconds on a fixed cycle, which is not modelled: each colour is costed on its own.
